title: Property-Based Testing API
description: Build a property-based testing API that verifies items are created correctly and all items share the same consistent shape.

steps.title: Create an item
steps.description: Create a POST /items endpoint that creates an item with name and price, returning 201.
hints: Accept JSON with name (string) and price (number)
Assign a unique id to each item

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
from pydantic import BaseModel
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

class ItemIn(BaseModel):
    name: str
    price: float

class Item(BaseModel):
    id: int
    name: str
    price: float

items = []
next_id = 1

@app.post('/items', status_code=201)
def create_item(item: ItemIn):
    global next_id
    new_item = Item(id=next_id, name=item.name, price=item.price)
    next_id += 1
    items.append(new_item)
    return new_item

steps.description: Add GET /items/:id that returns 200 and verify the id property exists in the response.
hints: Return the item by id, 404 if not found
Property: id should always exist and be a number
